name: End to end Cali Voice Analysis Agent

parameters.query:
SELECT table_name 
FROM information_schema.tables 
WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
AND table_name IN ('llm_analysis', 'calls', 'pipe_response', 'agent_results')

SELECT * FROM public.calls 
WHERE processed = FALSE AND skip = FALSE
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT {{$node["Workflow Initialization"].json["batch_size"]}}

UPDATE public.calls 
SET processed = TRUE, skip = TRUE, skip_reason = 'call duration <= 15 sec', 
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE callid = '{{$json.callid}}'

INSERT INTO public.agent_results 
(callid, agent_type, agent_result, processing_time_ms, error_occurred, error_message)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.callid}}', 
  '{{$json.agent_type}}', 
  '{{$json.result_json}}',
  {{$json.processing_time_ms}},
  {{$json.error_occurred}},
  '{{$json.error_message}}'
)
ON CONFLICT (callid, agent_type) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  agent_result = EXCLUDED.agent_result,
  processing_time_ms = EXCLUDED.processing_time_ms,
  error_occurred = EXCLUDED.error_occurred,
  error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
  created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
